phases.name: Foundation Cleanup
phases.goal: Remove user-facing confusion points — dead Allure plugin and legacy `--cucumberjson` CLI flag

phases.name: Code Quality Gates
phases.goal: Zero `return None` antipatterns in non-hook code; all exception handlers are specific or explicitly logged — gates refactoring for all subsequent phases

phases.name: Core Runtime Refactor
phases.goal: Split the 1422-line `scenario_run.py` god module into `model/run.py`, `model/scenario_run.py`, and `model/feature_binding.py` with zero behavior change

phases.name: Plugin Refactoring
phases.goal: All 17 plugins follow canonical class-based pattern; large formatter files reduced to maintainable size

phases.name: Unit Test Fortification
phases.goal: Comprehensive unit test coverage for core runtime, step definition, and parser modules

phases.name: Integration Testing
phases.goal: Contract-level integration tests for step matching priority and scenario execution lifecycle edge cases

phases.name: Documentation
phases.goal: Complete public API reference, developer guide, and user migration path

phases.name: BDD Acceptance Testing
phases.goal: Executable BDD feature tests cover previously undocumented behaviors and edge cases

phases.name: Compatibility Streamlining
phases.goal: Remove dead Python 2 shims and legacy dependencies; consolidate remaining compatibility layer

phases.name: Pattern Unification
phases.goal: Consistent programming patterns across all plugins and core modules — no cross-plugin imports, uniform StashBound usage

phases.name: Audit & Prune
phases.goal: Zero dead code, unused imports, or stale modules; full CI matrix validation

phases.name: Restructure test suite into semantic groups
phases.goal: Restructure the test suite so `tests/cases/` communicates semantic purpose, `tests/assets/` holds passive data only, shared active harness code lives under internal `src/pytest_bdd/testing/`, and Makefile targets are the documented human API for local, full, semantic, slow, and environment-specific runs.

phases.name: Unify cucumber-json plugins INI/CLI options
phases.goal: Unify the two existing cucumber-json reporter plugins (INI-configured and CLI-configured) into a single consolidated plugin with both configuration paths

phases.name: Gap Closure
phases.goal: Close v1.0 milestone audit gaps: achieve 70% unit test coverage (from 56%) and resolve 27 remaining BDD feature test failures (TEST-02)

phases.name: Cross-platform test suite entrypoint (Makefile + MinGW sh)
phases.goal: Add a Makefile-based test entrypoint that works across platforms including MinGW shell

phases.name: Move vulture dead-code gate from pytest to native pre-commit hook
phases.goal: Move vulture dead-code checking out of pytest and into the native pre-commit workflow.

phases.name: Adapt GitHub CI to use make and validate with act
phases.goal: Adapt the main GitHub Actions workflow to reuse Makefile targets for project-specific commands, while keeping GitHub Actions responsible for runner/toolchain setup.

phases.name: Split xdist-remote tests into separate parallel GHA executor job
phases.goal: [To be planned]

phases.name: HTML doc generation simplification
phases.goal: [To be planned]

phases.name: multiple refactorings
phases.goal: Elevate pytest-bdd-ng from 4-star to 5-star quality across three dimensions: type safety (mypy `--strict` compliance with zero errors), architecture (no file exceeds 400 LOC, plugins core/extra split, Go parser optional, explicit layered architecture), and documentation (object map with scores, responsibility contracts for every Python entity, API reference, 10 ADRs, 5 how-to guides).

phases.name: Test CLI scripts in a separate Cucumber Development flow
phases.goal: Add executable BDD coverage for repository development scripts, command-line tools, and pre-commit quality gates in a focused `features/18 Development/` flow.

phases.name: Replace Make&sh with Act
phases.goal: Replace Make and shell development entrypoints with local GitHub Actions workflow targets and Python command

phases.name: Extract pytest_bdd_toolchain
phases.goal: Extract `pytest_bdd_toolchain` into `pytest_bdd_toolchain` — a standalone package with all 11 development

phases.name: CCK Closure
phases.goal: Close CCK-01 through CCK-07 documentation gaps from v1.0 milestone audit — reconcile requirements, specs, and verification artifacts with actual implementation state.
